title: 3快专属游戏厅背景
intendedUse: 3分快开游戏专属子厅背景；网页覆盖投注规则、倒计时和难度档位。
prompt: Create a wide 3:2 premium casual 3D quick-draw game room environment. Three luminous abstract draw capsules with different simple geometric patterns sweep through a circular teal light track, with elegant motion trails and a soft clock-like halo in the distant background. Do not show digits, lottery balls with numerals, or a result. Keep the lower middle 45 percent dark, calm and uncluttered for HTML rules and difficulty cards. Match the shared Gameing Hall style: rounded polished 3D objects, deep teal and blue-green, ivory highlights, restrained warm gold, soft broad upper-left lighting, friendly premium casual-game finish.
